```{r Step 0: Pull in ANES Data, include=TRUE}
anes_panel <- read_dta(here("00_rawdata", "ANES_Data", "anes_timeseries_cdf_stata_20260205.dta"))
```

```{r Step 1: Cleaning Up the Dataset, include=TRUE}
# Check the variables
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(year = VCF0004, trust_gov_index = VCF0656, trust_gov = VCF0604, econ_views = VCF0870, stock_owns = VCF9224, social_class = VCF0149, person_finances = VCF0880, person_finances_scale = VCF0880a, personal_finances_next = VCF0881, age = VCF0101, age_group = VCF0102, gender = VCF0104, race = VCF0105a, educ = VCF0110, income_group = VCF0114, emp_status = VCF0116, homeowner = VCF0146, marital_stat = VCF0147, partisan_id = VCF0301, partisan_strength = VCF0305, pol_interest = VCF0310, union_mem = VCF0127)


#Initial Diagnostics
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    personal_finances_change = case_when(
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% 1:5 ~ as.numeric(person_finances_scale),
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    personal_finances_scale_factor = factor(
      personal_finances_change,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "Much better",
        "Somewhat better",
        "Same",
        "Somewhat worse",
        "Much worse"
      )
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    personal_finances_scale_clean = case_when(
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% 1:5 ~
        as.numeric(person_finances_scale),
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% c(8, 9) ~
        NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    personal_finance_direction = case_when(
      personal_finances_scale_clean %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Better",
      personal_finances_scale_clean == 3 ~ "Same",
      personal_finances_scale_clean %in% c(4, 5) ~ "Worse",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    personal_finance_direction = factor(
      personal_finance_direction,
      levels = c("Better", "Same", "Worse")
    )
  )
#Recoding Variables (Brought Over from Part 1)
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    trust_gov_index = na_if(trust_gov_index, 999)
  )

#Same Thing for Economic Views
anes_panel %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2024) %>%
  count(econ_views, sort = TRUE)

#Recode Data to Only show valid entries
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    trust_gov_index = na_if(trust_gov_index, 999),
    econ_views = case_when(
      econ_views %in% c(1, 3, 5) ~ econ_views,
      econ_views %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    # Trust
    trust_gov_index = if_else(
      trust_gov_index == 999,
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(trust_gov_index)
    ),

    # Economic views
    econ_views = case_when(
      as.numeric(econ_views) %in% c(1, 3, 5) ~ as.numeric(econ_views),
      as.numeric(econ_views) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Stock ownership
    stock_owns = case_when(
      as.numeric(stock_owns) == 1 ~ 1,
      as.numeric(stock_owns) == 2 ~ 0,
      as.numeric(stock_owns) %in% c(-8, -9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Homeownership
    homeowner = case_when(
      as.numeric(homeowner) == 1 ~ 1,
      as.numeric(homeowner) == 2 ~ 0,
      as.numeric(homeowner) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Income percentile group
    income_group = as.numeric(income_group)
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    econ_views_factor = factor(
      econ_views,
      levels = c(1, 3, 5),
      labels = c(
        "Get better",
        "Stay about the same",
        "Get worse"
      )
    ),

    income_group_factor = factor(
      income_group,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "0–16th percentile",
        "17–33rd percentile",
        "34–67th percentile",
        "68–95th percentile",
        "96–100th percentile"
      )
    )
  )

#Adding in new variable - external efficacy index
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(
    efficacy_index = VCF0648
  )

summary(anes_panel$efficacy_index)

table(
  anes_panel$efficacy_index,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    efficacy_index = case_when(
      as.numeric(efficacy_index) %in% 1:100 ~ as.numeric(efficacy_index),
      as.numeric(efficacy_index) >100 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) 

anes_panel %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(efficacy_index)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 0)

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(
    government_care = VCF0609
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    government_care = case_when(
      as.numeric(government_care) %in% 1:3 ~ as.numeric(government_care),
      as.numeric(government_care) == 9 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    government_care_factor = factor(
      government_care,
      levels = 1:3,
      labels = c(
        "Agree",
        "Disagree",
        "Neither"
      )
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(
    government_say = VCF0613
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    government_say = case_when(
      as.numeric(government_say) %in% 1:3 ~ as.numeric(government_say),
      as.numeric(government_say) == 9 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    government_say_factor = factor(
      government_say,
      levels = 1:3,
      labels = c(
        "Agree",
        "Disagree",
        "Neither"
      )
    )
  )

table(
  anes_panel$government_say,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Affirmative action:
    # Higher values = stronger support
    affirmative_action = case_when(
      as.numeric(VCF0867a) == 1 ~ 4,
      as.numeric(VCF0867a) == 2 ~ 3,
      as.numeric(VCF0867a) == 4 ~ 2,
      as.numeric(VCF0867a) == 5 ~ 1,
      as.numeric(VCF0867a) == 7 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    affirmative_action_factor = factor(
      affirmative_action,
      levels = 1:4,
      labels = c(
        "Oppose strongly",
        "Oppose not strongly",
        "Favor not strongly",
        "Favor strongly"
      )
    ),
    
    # Black hardworking/lazy:
    # Reverse the original scale so higher = more hardworking
    black_hardworking = case_when(
      as.numeric(VCF9271) %in% 1:7 ~
        8 - as.numeric(VCF9271),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    government_services = case_when(
      as.numeric(VCF0839) %in% 1:7 ~ as.numeric(VCF0839),
      as.numeric(VCF0839) == 9 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    government_jobs = case_when(
      as.numeric(VCF0809) %in% 1:7 ~ as.numeric(VCF0809),
      as.numeric(VCF0809) == 9 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    government_jobs_rev = case_when(
      government_jobs %in% 1:7 ~ 8 - government_jobs,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

black_anes <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    race == 2,
    year >= 2000,
    year <= 2024
  )

white_anes <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    race == 1,
    year >= 2000,
    year <= 2024
  )


#Turn Dataset into Survey Object
anes_svy <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(year >= 2000) %>%
  as_survey_design(
    ids = 1,
    weights = VCF0009z
  ) 

black_svy <- black_anes %>%
  as_survey_design(
    ids = 1,
    weights = VCF0009z
  )

anes_step7 <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    year %in% c(2000, 2002, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2024),
    race %in% c(1, 2)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_2024 = if_else(year == 2024, 1, 0),
    race_factor = factor(
      race,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("White", "Black")
    )
  )

#Diagnostic Plots 
composition_table <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    year %in% c(2000, 2002, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020, 2024),
    race %in% c(1, 2)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    race_factor = factor(
      race,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("White", "Black")
    ),
    stock_factor = factor(
      stock_owns,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Non-stock owner", "Stock owner")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, race_factor) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    stock_ownership_pct = mean(stock_owns == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

composition_table

income_stock_composition <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    year %in% c(2000, 2002, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020, 2024),
    race %in% c(1, 2),
    !is.na(income_group_factor),
    !is.na(stock_owns)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    race_factor = factor(
      race,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("White", "Black")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, race_factor, income_group_factor) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    stock_owner_pct = mean(stock_owns == 1) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

income_stock_composition

weighted_stock_composition <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    year %in% c(2000, 2002, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020, 2024),
    race %in% c(1, 2),
    !is.na(income_group_factor),
    !is.na(stock_owns),
    !is.na(VCF0009z)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    race_factor = factor(
      race,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("White", "Black")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, race_factor, income_group_factor) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    
    design_cell <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = .x
    )
    
    estimate <- survey::svymean(
      ~stock_owns,
      design = design_cell,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    data.frame(
      n = nrow(.x),
      weighted_stock_pct = as.numeric(coef(estimate)) * 100,
      se = as.numeric(SE(estimate)) * 100
    )
    
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    race_factor,
    income_group_factor
  )

weighted_stock_composition_clean <- weighted_stock_composition %>%
  mutate(
    weighted_stock_pct = round(weighted_stock_pct, 1),
    se = round(se, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(
    year,
    race_factor,
    income_group_factor,
    n,
    weighted_stock_pct,
    se
  )

weighted_stock_composition_clean
#The composition analysis indicates substantial growth in stock ownership among lower- and middle-income respondents between 2016 and 2020, particularly among Black respondents in the middle of the income distribution. However, the resulting compositional change does not by itself account for the temporal interaction in affirmative-action attitudes, which concerns the conditional relationship between income, stock ownership, and attitudes. Small cell sizes among Black respondents at the very top of the income distribution warrant caution in interpreting estimates for that group.
```

```{r Step 2: 2024 Break Analysis for Affirmative Action, include=TRUE}
affirmative_step7 <- anes_step7 %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(affirmative_action),
    !is.na(income_group_factor),
    !is.na(stock_owns),
    !is.na(VCF0009z)
  )

design_affirmative_step7 <- survey::svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~VCF0009z,
  data = affirmative_step7
)

m_affirmative_step7 <- survey::svyglm(
  affirmative_action ~
    year_2024 *
    income_group_factor *
    stock_owns,
  design = design_affirmative_step7
)

summary(m_affirmative_step7)

survey::regTermTest(
  m_affirmative_step7,
  ~ year_2024:income_group_factor:stock_owns
)

m_affirmative_race_step7 <- survey::svyglm(
  affirmative_action ~
    race_factor *
    year_2024 *
    income_group_factor *
    stock_owns,
  design = design_affirmative_step7
)

survey::regTermTest(
  m_affirmative_race_step7,
  ~ race_factor:
    year_2024:
    income_group_factor:
    stock_owns
)

affirmative_predictions_step7 <- marginaleffects::predictions(
  m_affirmative_race_step7,
  newdata = marginaleffects::datagrid(
    race_factor = c("White", "Black"),
    year_2024 = c(0, 1),
    income_group_factor =
      levels(model.frame(m_affirmative_race_step7)$income_group_factor),
    stock_owns = c(0, 1)
  )
) %>%
  as.data.frame()

affirmative_predictions_step7

#Next Step
affirmative_step7_year <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    year %in% c(2016, 2020, 2024),
    race %in% c(1, 2),
    !is.na(affirmative_action),
    !is.na(income_group_factor),
    !is.na(stock_owns),
    !is.na(VCF0009z)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    race_factor = factor(
      race,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("White", "Black")
    ),
    year_factor = factor(
      year,
      levels = c(2016, 2020, 2024)
    )
  )

design_affirmative_year <- survey::svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~VCF0009z,
  data = affirmative_step7_year
)

m_affirmative_year <- survey::svyglm(
  affirmative_action ~
    race_factor *
    year_factor *
    income_group_factor *
    stock_owns,
  design = design_affirmative_year
)

survey::regTermTest(
  m_affirmative_year,
  ~ year_factor:
    income_group_factor:
    stock_owns
)

survey::regTermTest(
  m_affirmative_year,
  ~ race_factor:
    year_factor:
    income_group_factor:
    stock_owns
)

affirmative_predictions_year <- marginaleffects::predictions(
  m_affirmative_year,
  newdata = marginaleffects::datagrid(
    race_factor = c("White", "Black"),
    year_factor = c("2016", "2020", "2024"),
    income_group_factor =
      levels(model.frame(m_affirmative_year)$income_group_factor),
    stock_owns = c(0, 1)
  )
) %>%
  as.data.frame()

affirmative_predictions_year %>%
  select(
    race_factor,
    year_factor,
    income_group_factor,
    stock_owns,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    race_factor,
    year_factor,
    income_group_factor,
    stock_owns
  )

stock_effects <- affirmative_predictions_year %>%
  select(
    race_factor,
    year_factor,
    income_group_factor,
    stock_owns,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = stock_owns,
    values_from = c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    names_glue = "{.value}_stock{stock_owns}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stock_effect = estimate_stock1 - estimate_stock0,
    stock_effect_low = conf.low_stock1 - conf.high_stock0,
    stock_effect_high = conf.high_stock1 - conf.low_stock0
  )

stock_effects

stock_effects %>%
  select(
    race_factor,
    year_factor,
    income_group_factor,
    stock_effect,
    stock_effect_low,
    stock_effect_high
  )

ggplot(
  stock_effects,
  aes(
    x = income_group_factor,
    y = stock_effect,
    group = year_factor,
    linetype = year_factor
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ race_factor) +
  labs(
    x = "Income group",
    y = "Predicted difference: stock owners − non-stock owners",
    linetype = "Year",
    title = "Association between stock ownership and affirmative-action attitudes",
    subtitle = "Income-specific differences by race and election year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```
